jobs.description:
About the Boerma Instituut

The Boerma Instituut was founded in 1980 by Theo and Jose Boerma and is currently led by Jacqueline Boerma, fourth generation of a family with more than 120 years of experience in floral design.

The school offers foundation courses, international programmes, workshops, masterclasses and the Master Florist programme (Meesterbinder). Our mission is to train students from all over the world to become professional florists and floral designers.

Position

As a Floral Design Instructor, you will teach classical and modern floral design, guide international students and represent the school abroad. The role includes teaching in the Netherlands as well as international travel.

Responsibilities

- Teach International Vocational, Advanced and Master Florist programmes, levels 1 to 3
- Teach hand-tied bouquet courses and floral courses for funerals, weddings and events
- Provide private lessons and group training
- Prepare lessons, order materials and create sample pieces
- Coach and mentor students
- Support competitions, events and open days
- Travel internationally to teach and demonstrate on behalf of the school

Requirements

- Master Florist Diploma (Meesterbinder) with transcript
- Average grade of 8 or international equivalent
- Transcript must be submitted
- Knowledge of the Golden Ratio, proportion, Fibonacci composition and asymmetrical floral design
- Teaching experience at Master Florist level is required
- Extensive portfolio of own work; the portfolio must be submitted before the interview
- Knowledge of colour theory and correct nomenclature of flowers, plants and materials
- Willingness to learn Dutch
- English is currently the working language
- Minimum of 10 years of professional floral design experience
- Minimum of 3 years of teaching or training experience
- Experience with international competitions and demonstrations
- Valid category B driving licence
- Strong artistic vision, technical skills, pedagogical skills and flexibility to travel internationally

Do you possess an IRATA Level 3 certificate, are you technically skilled, and do you enjoy working at heights? Do you enjoy leading and supervising operational teams, with a keen eye for safety and quality, and do you also like to roll up your sleeves? • With a valid IRATA level 3 certificate (hard demand)

________________________________________

SSAB Services, Hardox Wearparts is a rapidly growing business unit with ambitious targets. As Business & Technical Development Manager for Hardox Wearparts you will be an integral part of building and implementing a new business model. 

You will participate in the development and conceptualization of the new business model, including the future product and service mix as well as the go-to market setup. Placement is optional.

Responsibilities include

•Business concept: Conceptualization and structuring of existing knowledge in order to define the  service offer

•Product and service portfolio evaluation and definition

•Development of trainings and manuals

•Piloting the new concept, preparing for future concept sales

•Mapping end user needs to ensure concept success

You will report to the Head of Hardox Wearparts Concept Management.

Your qualifications
To be successful in this role you need to have a master degree in engineering or equivalent. 

We believe that you have at least 5 years experience of working with wear products and/or maintenance in the one of the aggregates industries. You have strong social skills and experience from successfully driving and implementing development. 

You have a curious mind and strong analytical skills paired with good technical understanding of wear in practice (maintenance and wear products). As a lot of the future development will have a strong connection to digital tools and systems development, you need an overall understanding of the possibilities that exist within digital development. 

You are fluent in English and thrive in an international environment where global contacts are part of the every day work. Speaking Dutch is a plus as the position wil be based in the Netherlands.

As a person you are positive and interested in new ideas - and in making them happen. 

We offer
You will be part of, and have the possibility to grow within, an international and dynamic organization that is developing rapidly. Hardox Wearparts has ambitious growth targets and as a vital member of the development team, you will contribute to our future success. 

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Fluency in one or more of the following language combinations: Dutch + English, German + English, German + English + French, or German + English + Dutch

• Trilingual candidates are highly valued

• Additional language skills may qualify for a language bonus

• Upper secondary education completed

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in customer service or a related field

• Availability for rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00 (potential for homeworking)

• Full-time availability

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

Warehouse Operator | Flexible Schedule

Are you looking for a side job or a part-time position?

 Can you work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM on a weekly basis? Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too!

For our client TVH in Waregem (located near the E17 motorway), we are looking for warehouse employees who would like to work on a flexible schedule.

We are looking for people to sort and unpack incoming parts and goods.

Your responsibilities will include:

 

 
• Sorting delivered goods. 
 
• Physically removing parts and goods from their packaging. 
 
• Checking quantities and stock counts. 
 
• Taking the initiative to keep the workplace clean and tidy. 
 
• Following all safety rules and procedures. 

 
• You can work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too! 
 
• You work accurately and are disciplined in following instructions. 
 
• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 
 
• Physical work is not a problem for you (lifting and carrying items).
